formats.key: buyArtworks(bytes32 r_,bytes32 s_,uint8 v_,(uint256 price,uint256 cost,uint256 expiryTime,address destination,uint256[] tokenIds,(address recipient,uint256 bps)[][] revenueShares,bool payByVaultContract) saleData_)
effects: When payByVaultContract is false, the signer pays msg.value, which must equal saleData_.price, in ETH.
When payByVaultContract is true, the Feral File vault pays the price; any ETH the signer sends is not checked and stays in the contract.
The listed artworks move from the contract to saleData_.destination.
Part of the price (price minus cost, split per token) goes to the revenue share recipients by bps; the rest goes to the costReceiver from storage.
formats.shown: Purchase artworks for <destination>, with Price, Platform cost, Recipient, Artworks, Offer expires, a raw Pay via vault flag, and nested revenue share fields.

findings.title: buyArtworks is payable with no @.value field; in the vault path the ETH sent is unchecked.
findings.evidence: FeralfileArtworkV4.sol buyArtworks: `saleData_.payByVaultContract ? vault.payForSale(r_, s_, v_, saleData_) : require(saleData_.price == msg.value, ...)`. Only the non-vault path ties msg.value to price. The descriptor has no `@.value` field.
findings.fix: Add a field {"path":"@.value","label":"You pay","format":"amount"} and mention it in interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: buyArtworks 'Platform cost' reads like a fee on top of the price; it is a part of it.
findings.evidence: buyArtworks: `itemRevenue = (saleData_.price - saleData_.cost) / saleData_.tokenIds.length;` and `leftOver = saleData_.price - distributedRevenue` goes to costReceiver. The signer pays `price` only. Descriptor label "Platform cost".
findings.fix: Change the label to "Platform cost (included in price)".

findings.title: buyArtworks shows 'Pay via vault' as a raw true/false with no meaning for the signer.
findings.evidence: descriptor field `saleData_.payByVaultContract` "format": "raw"; case 6 renders "false". When true the vault pays the price, not the signer.
findings.fix: Use an enum: false = "You pay the price", true = "Feral File vault pays".

findings.title: buyArtworks interpolated intent leaves out the price the signer pays.
findings.evidence: descriptor: "interpolatedIntent": "Buy artworks for {saleData_.destination}"; case 6 renders "Buy artworks for Receiver" while 0.5 ETH leaves the wallet.
findings.fix: Change interpolatedIntent to "Buy artworks {saleData_.tokenIds} for {saleData_.price} to {saleData_.destination}" or similar, with at most three fields.

findings.title: buyArtworks revenue shares are a nested array that runners do not iterate.
findings.evidence: descriptor paths `saleData_.revenueShares.[].[].recipient` and `.[].[].bps` (bps raw). Code pays `itemRevenue * bps / 10000` to each recipient. Fix waits on the runners.

findings.title: buyArtworks test covers only the direct-pay path with empty revenue shares.
findings.evidence: Case 6: revenueShares array length 0 and payByVaultContract false; no case with vault payment or non-empty shares.
findings.fix: Add cases with payByVaultContract true and with revenue shares.

effects: Sets mintable to false permanently; no function sets it back, so the owner can never mint again.

findings.title: startSale permanently disables minting; the intent says only 'Start artwork sale'.
findings.evidence: FeralfileArtworkV4.sol startSale: `mintable = false; resumeSale();`. No setter restores mintable; mintArtworks requires `mintable`. Descriptor intent "Start artwork sale".
findings.fix: Change the intent to "Start sale and close minting forever".
